title: openai-chat-completions-parity: support roles, stop, logprobs, structured responses, streaming stability fixes
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: bring Redwood's /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer closer to OpenAI semantics for chat usage and address streaming instability observed in long-lived streams. This PR implements: 1) role preservation and validation: honor system/assistant/user roles in incoming messages and map legacy internal role enums to OpenAI roles; 2) stop token handling: support single and multiple 'stop' sequences, ensure stop triggers finalization of streams and non-streamed responses with proper finish_reason; 3) logprobs passthrough: expose token-level logprobs and top_logprobs when requested by client (with privacy guardrails); 4) structured output helpers: add content parsing hints and content_format in compatibility layer to make deterministic structured outputs easier for downstream SDKs; 5) streaming stability fixes: reduce duplicate final chunks, flush KV-cache on model-switches, add heartbeat keepalive and resumable stream markers; 6) coverage: expanded unit + integration tests across openai-compat adapter and js/python SDK examples. Backwards compatibility: existing Redwood JSON response shapes are preserved when not using OpenAI compatibility mode. See Linear tasks ENG-4821/ENG-4980 for rollout plan and compatibility notes.
